theme: An open day, with two travel bookings whose clocks are finally running.
greeting: The calendar's empty today, Dan — the whole day is yours. The real pull is a short stack of overdue travel bookings; two of them have deadlines that are actually moving now.

needsAttention.title: Hold the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Your own p1 note, now about four weeks past its date: a full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out. A refundable hold costs nothing and takes the whole risk off the table.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December-break destination
needsAttention.detail: Your book-by date is Thursday, Oct 15 — three days out. Holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year; pick domestic or international, then book before it closes.

flagged.title: LinkedIn reply waiting
flagged.detail: Abijah Kanene is waiting on a response via LinkedIn — worth a glance if it's a networking thread.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promos — NYT Cooking, Responsible Investor, a few retail sales, a real-estate alert.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox needs a reply from you today.

recipe.title: Apple Butterscotch Tart
recipe.why: Autumn is apple season, and a butterscotch tart puts the orchard's windfall to its best use.
